headline: Monsters Hold the Top Spot as Crushers and Rafters Surge
lede: Monsters are still on top, and the numbers say they earned it. Crushers and Rafters are the hot movers, and Nemesis fell hard for no good reason. Sources say the middle of the table is about to get very crowded.

rankings.blurb: Monsters hold the No. 1 spot with a 78.6% all-play mark and a 3-game winning streak, and nobody in the league scores more consistently over a full season.
BearCats are rolling on an 11-game winning streak and a league-best 189.3 PPG over the last three weeks, and the heater is real.
Foxes slipped one spot, but a 187.1 PPG stretch over the last three weeks and a 7-game streak keep them in the thick of it.
Hurricanes sit at No. 4 with a 73.0% all-play mark, and the 19.5-point season margin tells you this roster is built to win.
Crushers jumped seven spots, and a 10-game winning streak with a 37.8-point season margin is exactly why the league is buzzing about them.
Hoosiers climbed to No. 6 with a 72.3% all-play mark, and I'm told the front office is quietly happy with how the roster is holding up.
Jockeys dropped a spot despite an 8-game winning streak, and a 24.4-point season margin says the decline is more about the schedule than the roster.
Waves inched up to No. 8 on 182.7 PPG over the last three weeks, a scoring surge that has quietly moved them into the top 10.
Nemesis fell four spots from No. 5 even with a 73.4% all-play mark, and sources say the fall is more about bad luck than bad play.
Rafters jumped five spots to No. 10 with a 177.6 PPG stretch over the last three weeks, and the highest score of the week gave them plenty of attention.
Chickens dropped three spots to No. 11, but a 70.9% all-play mark and a 20.7-point season margin keep them dangerous.
Razerbacks climbed seven spots to No. 12, and a 71.7% all-play mark shows this team is finally playing to its roster's potential.
Assassins rocketed up 15 spots to No. 13 with a 4-game winning streak, and the front office deserves credit for turning things around fast.
Roos slipped one spot to No. 14 despite a 5-1 record over the last three weeks, and a 15.7-point season margin says the roster is still solid.
Yetis climbed three spots to No. 15 on a 67.7% all-play mark, and a 22.4-point season margin is the kind of number contenders notice.
Freeze rocketed up 15 spots to No. 16 with a 5-game winning streak, and nobody saw that jump coming a few weeks ago.
Demons dropped seven spots to No. 17 despite a 71.1% all-play mark, and the 150.5 PPG over the last three weeks is the problem.
SnakeEyes surged 17 spots to No. 18 with a 6-game winning streak, and the 13.4-point season margin proves the turnaround is real.
Gladiators jumped 17 spots to No. 19 on a 59.3% all-play mark, and a 2-game streak is enough to keep the momentum going.
Tombstones dropped three spots to No. 20 despite a 165.6 season PPG, the second-best scoring mark in the league, and sources say the cold stretch is temporary.
RailRoaders climbed six spots to No. 21 with a 64.1% all-play mark, and the team is finally putting it together.
Monkeys slipped six spots to No. 22 with a 155.0 season PPG, and the 22.9-point season margin says they are still a dangerous team.
Dawgs held steady at No. 23 with a 62.7% all-play mark, and sources say the front office is still weighing its options.
Cellmates edged up one spot to No. 24 with a 5-1 record over the last three weeks, and a 14.9-point season margin shows real staying power.
SaltyDogs fell four spots to No. 25 despite a 3-game winning streak, and a 58.7% all-play mark is the number that will keep them up at night.

statOfWeek.title: Stat of the Week
statOfWeek.blurb: Rafters dropped 193.40 this week, the highest score in the league. I'm told the owner is still celebrating.

benchBlunder.title: Bench Blunder of the Week
benchBlunder.blurb: Hippos left 68.44 points on the bench this week, a brutal gap between 70.04 actual and 138.48 optimal. Ouch.

heaterOfWeek.title: Heater of the Week
heaterOfWeek.blurb: BearCats have won 11 straight, the longest active win streak in the league. This is the heater everyone is chasing.

coolerOfWeek.title: Cooler of the Week
coolerOfWeek.blurb: Nordics have dropped 10 in a row, the longest active losing streak in the league. Sources say the locker room is quiet.

matchupOfWeek.title: Matchup of the Week
matchupOfWeek.blurb: Week 12 brings the highest-ranked clash on the slate: No. 10 Rafters at No. 9 Nemesis. Circle it.
